# Code of conduct

This project follows the
[Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be kind and patient, assume good faith, and keep feedback about the
work, not the person. Harassment, insults, and personal or political attacks
are not acceptable in issues, pull requests or anywhere else in this
repository.

## Reporting

Write to esalameh@proton.me. Reports are read only by the maintainer and kept
confidential. Behaviour that breaks this code can lead to comments being
hidden or removed, and to a temporary or permanent block from the repository.
